fusions.name: Strand Lash
fusions.desc: Whips a spray of strands at a target up to 5 tiles away, dealing 4 damage with a 35% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Snarled Bristle
fusions.desc: Bristles every plate and strand, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and hindering their attacks for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Silk Snare
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 5 enemies within 7 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Fine Filaments
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and you regenerate 0.4 health a second permanently.
